1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """One door for every model call a tool makes — priced, consented and recorded before it is sent.
3: 
4: The cost rule, in the order work is tried:
5: 
6:   1. decidable            -> code. It never reaches this module.
7:   2. a typed judgement    -> Jev (`jev()`): yes/no, one of a set, a score. Per call.
8:   3. generation           -> an OpenRouter model whose listed price is 0, sent with
9:                              provider.data_collection = "deny". Nothing else, ever.
10:   4. synthesis            -> the Claude agent that called the tool. Not routed.
11: 
12: Three guards are code, not prose (P1), and each says what it could not check (P23):
13: 
14: - **Free only.** A model is used only if it is OpenRouter's declared `:free` variant
15:   AND every price its catalogue lists is 0 — neither the name nor the price alone —
16:   and a response that reports `usage.cost > 0` stops the run.
17: - **Consent.** `Plan/runs/route/consent.json` (decision 007) names the documents
18:   that may be sent. A call declaring any other document is refused, and so is any
19:   request containing twelve consecutive words of a landed document outside the
20:   consent. Blind to: paraphrase, translation, and runs shorter than twelve words.
21: - **Recorded.** Every answered call is kept under `Plan/runs/route/calls/`, so a
22:   run replays offline, free and without a key (P5), and every call — answered,
23:   cached, refused or unreached — is a line in `Plan/runs/route/ledger.jsonl`.
24: 
25: A call that never returned is **unreached**, never a bad answer (P15), and an empty
26: or truncated answer is a defect that moves on to the next model (P19).
27: 
28:     python3 scripts/route.py models             # probe free models under the data policy
29:     python3 scripts/route.py serve [--port N]   # OpenAI-compatible proxy for third-party tools
30:     python3 scripts/route.py ledger             # what was called, by whom, at what cost
31:     python3 scripts/route.py guard <slug>       # would this document's text be refused?
32:     python3 scripts/route.py selftest           # offline: no key, no network
33:     echo PROMPT | python3 scripts/route.py complete --purpose P --doc SLUG
34: 
35: **The proxy.** A tool that takes an OpenAI base URL is pointed at
36: `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1` and names itself in the API key it sends —
37: `route:<purpose>:<doc>` — so it never holds a real key. Whatever model it asks for,
38: it gets a free one; `/v1/embeddings` is answered locally by a multilingual
39: sentence-transformers model when the proxy runs under an interpreter that has one
40: (`.venv-grawiki/bin/python`), because no free embedding model on OpenRouter
41: accepts the data policy. `serve --replay` answers only from the recording.
42: 
43: Jev needs `typesafe_sdk`: run the caller with `.venv-typesafe/bin/python`.
44: """

115: def check_doc(doc: str | None) -> str | None:

128: def shingles(text: str) -> set[int]:
129:     w = WORD.findall(text.lower())
130:     return {hash(tuple(w[i:i + SHINGLE])) for i in range(len(w) - SHINGLE + 1)}

133: class Guard:
134:     """Every twelve-word run of a landed document the consent does not cover.
135: 
136:     A run the consented documents also contain is theirs to send, so boilerplate
137:     shared with them never refuses. Hashes are per process, never stored."""
138: 
139:     def __init__(self) -> None:
140:         allowed = set(consent()["documents"])
141:         mine: set[int] = set()
142:         self.foreign: set[int] = set()
143:         self.documents = self.blind = 0
144:         for d in subject.documents():
145:             s = shingles(d.body)
146:             if not s:
147:                 self.blind += 1          # shorter than one run: nothing to recognise it by
148:             if d.slug in allowed:
149:                 mine |= s
150:             else:
151:                 self.foreign |= s
152:                 self.documents += 1
153:         self.foreign -= mine
154: 
155:     def breach(self, text: str) -> list[str]:
156:         hits = shingles(text) & self.foreign
157:         if not hits:
158:             return []
159:         # Rare path: name the documents, so a refusal says whose text it was.
160:         return sorted({d.slug for d in subject.documents() if shingles(d.body) & hits})

207: def is_free(model: dict) -> bool:
208:     """Listed price 0 for every listed price, AND OpenRouter's declared `:free` variant.
209: 
210:     Price alone let in, on 2026-09-24, two music models (google/lyria-3-*), a
211:     meta-router that picks its own model (openrouter/free) and a stealth preview —
212:     none of them a text model whose terms anyone checked. The `:free` tier is the
213:     one OpenRouter declares; a name alone is never enough either."""
214:     if not str(model.get("id", "")).endswith(":free"):
215:         return False
216:     pricing = model.get("pricing") or {}
217:     if "prompt" not in pricing or "completion" not in pricing:
218:         return False
219:     try:
220:         return all(float(v) == 0 for v in pricing.values() if v not in (None, ""))
221:     except (TypeError, ValueError):
222:         return False
223:

225: def _post(url: str, body: dict | None, timeout: int = TIMEOUT) -> tuple[int, dict]:
226:     """The one network call. Returns (status, json); selftest replaces it."""
227:     key = os.environ.get("OPENROUTER_API_KEY")
228:     if not key:
229:         return 0, {"error": {"message": "OPENROUTER_API_KEY is not set"}}
230:     req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),
231:                                  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json",
232:                                           "X-Title": "kohaerenzprotokoll route.py"})
233:     try:
234:         with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
235:             return r.status, json.load(r)
236:     except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
237:         raw = e.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
238:         try:
239:             return e.code, json.loads(raw)
240:         except ValueError:
241:             return e.code, {"error": {"message": raw[:300]}}
242:     except Exception as e:  # timeout, reset, DNS: not an answer (P15)
243:         return 0, {"error": {"message": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300]}}
244:

246: def _classify(status: int, body: dict) -> str:
247:     msg = json.dumps(body.get("error", body), ensure_ascii=False)
248:     if status == 404 and "data policy" in msg:
249:         return "data-policy"
250:     if status == 429:
251:         return "rate-limited"
252:     if status in (401, 403):
253:         return "forbidden"
254:     return "error"

267: def rotation(prefer: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
268:     """Free chat models that accepted the data policy: answered first, rate-limited after."""
269:     chat = catalogue()["chat"]
270:     ok = sorted((m for m, v in chat.items() if v["status"] == "ok"), key=lambda m: chat[m].get("seconds", 99))
271:     later = sorted(m for m, v in chat.items() if v["status"] == "rate-limited")
272:     order = ok + later
273:     if prefer in order:
274:         order.remove(prefer)
275:         order.insert(0, prefer)
276:     t = time.time()
277:     warm = [m for m in order if _COOLING.get(m, 0) <= t]
278:     return warm + [m for m in order if m not in warm]

281: def lang(text: str) -> str | None:
282:     """'de', 'en' or None — enough to catch an English answer to a German task (P19)."""
283:     w = [x.lower() for x in WORD.findall(text)]
284:     de = sum(x in {"der", "die", "das", "und", "ist", "nicht", "ein", "eine", "mit", "von", "den", "im",
285:                    "auf", "für", "sich", "des", "auch", "als", "wird", "zu"} for x in w)
286:     en = sum(x in {"the", "and", "is", "not", "a", "of", "to", "in", "for", "with", "on", "as", "by",
287:                    "be", "this", "that", "are", "it"} for x in w)
288:     if de + en < 3:
289:         return None
290:     return "de" if de > en else "en"

293: def chat(request: dict, *, purpose: str, doc: str | None = None, prefer: str | None = None,
294:          expect: str | None = None, attempt: int = 0) -> dict:
295:     """One chat completion from a free model, or {"unreached": why}.
296: 
297:     `request` is an OpenAI chat body without `model`. Raises Refused only for a
298:     consent breach or a charged call; a model's failure is never raised."""
299:     doc = check_doc(doc)
300:     request = {k: v for k, v in request.items()
301:                if k not in ("model", "models", "stream", "stream_options", "provider", "route", "user")}
302:     screen(json.dumps(request.get("messages", []), ensure_ascii=False), purpose, doc)
303:     # attempt > 0 is a deliberate repeat (P18): a fresh call, never the first one replayed
304:     key = digest({**request, "attempt": attempt} if attempt else request)
305:     rec = recall("chat", key)
306:     if rec is not None:
307:         ledger(kind="chat", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=True, outcome="ok",
308:                model=rec["model"], cost=0)
309:         return rec
310:     if REPLAY:
311:         ledger(kind="chat", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=False, outcome="unreached",
312:                why="not in the recording")
313:         return {"unreached": "not in the recording"}
314:     models = rotation(prefer)
315:     tried: list[dict] = []
316:     for model in models + models:            # each model twice, in order, before giving up
317:         if len(tried) >= 2 * len(models):
318:             break
319:         if _COOLING.get(model, 0) > time.time() and any(_COOLING.get(m, 0) <= time.time() for m in models):
320:             continue
321:         body = {**request, "model": model, "provider": {"data_collection": "deny"}, "usage": {"include": True}}
322:         t = time.time()
323:         status, resp = _post(f"{API}/chat/completions", body)
324:         took = round(time.time() - t, 1)
325:         if status != 200 or "choices" not in resp:
326:             why = _classify(status, resp) if status else "unreached"
327:             if why == "rate-limited":
328:                 _COOLING[model] = time.time() + COOL
329:             tried.append({"model": model, "status": status, "why": why, "seconds": took})
330:             time.sleep(1 if why == "rate-limited" else 0)
331:             continue
332:         usage = resp.get("usage") or {}
333:         cost = usage.get("cost")
334:         if cost:
335:             ledger(kind="chat", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=False, outcome="charged",
336:                    model=model, cost=cost)
337:             raise Refused(f"{model} charged {cost} although listed free — stopping (decision 007)")
338:         choice = resp["choices"][0]
339:         msg = choice.get("message") or {}
340:         content = msg.get("content") or ""
341:         defect = None
342:         if not content.strip() and not msg.get("tool_calls"):
343:             defect = "empty"
344:         elif choice.get("finish_reason") == "length":
345:             defect = "truncated"
346:         elif expect and content.strip() and lang(content) not in (None, expect):
347:             defect = f"language {lang(content)}"
348:         if defect:
349:             tried.append({"model": model, "status": status, "why": defect, "seconds": took})
350:             continue
351:         rec = {"model": resp.get("model", model), "provider": resp.get("provider"), "seconds": took,
352:                "content": content, "response": resp, "tried": tried}
353:         store("chat", key, rec)
354:         ledger(kind="chat", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=False, outcome="ok",
355:                model=rec["model"], provider=rec["provider"], seconds=took,
356:                prompt_tokens=usage.get("prompt_tokens"), completion_tokens=usage.get("completion_tokens"),
357:                cost=cost if cost is not None else None, attempts=len(tried) + 1)
358:         return rec
359:     why = "; ".join(f"{t['model']}: {t['why']}" for t in tried[-4:]) or "no model in the rotation"
360:     ledger(kind="chat", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=False, outcome="unreached",
361:            why=why[:400], attempts=len(tried))
362:     return {"unreached": why, "tried": tried}

365: def complete(prompt: str, *, purpose: str, doc: str | None = None, max_tokens: int = 4000,
366:              json_mode: bool = False, expect: str | None = None, attempt: int = 0) -> dict:
367:     request = {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], "max_tokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0}
368:     if json_mode:
369:         request["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}
370:     return chat(request, purpose=purpose, doc=doc, expect=expect, attempt=attempt)

373: # ── Jev ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

375: def _questions(spec: dict):
376:     """JSON question specs -> typesafe_sdk questions. Validates before any call."""
377:     from typesafe_sdk import Choice, Noul, NoulCriteria, Score
378:     out = {}
379:     for k, q in spec.items():
380:         kind, instr, crit = q.get("type"), q.get("instructions"), q.get("criteria")
381:         if kind == "noul":
382:             out[k] = Noul(instructions=instr, criteria=NoulCriteria(true=crit["true"], false=crit["false"]))
383:         elif kind == "choice":
384:             out[k] = Choice(instructions=instr, criteria=dict(crit))
385:         elif kind == "score":
386:             if not 2 <= len(crit) <= 10:
387:                 raise ValueError(f"{k}: a Score takes 2-10 levels; eleven is a server error (typesafe skill)")
388:             out[k] = Score(instructions=instr, criteria=list(crit))
389:         else:
390:             raise ValueError(f"{k}: type must be noul, choice or score, not {kind!r}")
391:     return out
392:

394: def jev(state: dict, questions: dict, *, purpose: str, doc: str | None = None) -> dict:
395:     """Typed answers from Jev, or {"unreached": why}. Questions are JSON specs:
396:     {"type": "noul", "instructions": ..., "criteria": {"true": ..., "false": ...}},
397:     {"type": "choice", ..., "criteria": {label: description}},
398:     {"type": "score", ..., "criteria": [level, ...]} (2-10 levels, ordered)."""
399:     doc = check_doc(doc)
400:     screen(json.dumps([state, questions], ensure_ascii=False), purpose, doc)
401:     key = digest({"state": state, "questions": questions})
402:     rec = recall("jev", key)
403:     if rec is not None:
404:         ledger(kind="jev", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=True, outcome="ok", model=rec["model"])
405:         return rec
406:     if REPLAY:
407:         return {"unreached": "not in the recording"}
408:     try:
409:         from typesafe_sdk import RetryPolicy, TypeSafeClient
410:         qs = _questions(questions)
411:     except ImportError:
412:         return {"unreached": "typesafe_sdk is not importable — run with .venv-typesafe/bin/python"}
413:     t = time.time()
414:     try:
415:         with TypeSafeClient(timeout=120, retry=RetryPolicy(max_retries=5, backoff_initial=1.0,
416:                                                            backoff_max=20.0)) as c:
417:             r = c.system_one(state=state, questions=qs)
418:     except Exception as e:
419:         why = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300]
420:         ledger(kind="jev", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=False, outcome="unreached", why=why)
421:         return {"unreached": why}
422:     answers = {}
423:     for k in questions:
424:         a = r.answers[k]
425:         answers[k] = {f: (dict(getattr(a, f)) if f == "probabilities" else getattr(a, f))
426:                       for f in ("noul", "choice", "score", "confidence", "probabilities")
427:                       if getattr(a, f, None) is not None}
428:     rec = {"model": r.model, "seconds": round(time.time() - t, 2),
429:            "input_tokens": r.usage.input_tokens, "answers": answers}
430:     store("jev", key, rec)
431:     ledger(kind="jev", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, key=key, cached=False, outcome="ok", model=r.model,
432:            seconds=rec["seconds"], prompt_tokens=rec["input_tokens"], cost=None)
433:     return rec

438: _EMBEDDER = None
439: EMBED_LOCK = threading.Lock()

442: def embedder():
443:     global _EMBEDDER
444:     with EMBED_LOCK:        # ~60 s on first load: never under the ledger's lock
445:         if _EMBEDDER is None:
446:             from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer  # .venv-grawiki has it
447:             _EMBEDDER = SentenceTransformer(EMBED_MODEL, device="cpu")
448:     return _EMBEDDER

451: def embed(texts: list[str], *, purpose: str, doc: str | None = None) -> list[list[float]]:
452:     doc = check_doc(doc)
453:     screen("\n".join(texts), purpose, doc)
454:     vectors = embedder().encode(texts, normalize_embeddings=True).tolist()
455:     ledger(kind="embed", purpose=purpose, doc=doc, cached=False, outcome="ok",
456:            model=f"local/{EMBED_MODEL}", inputs=len(texts), cost=0)
457:     return vectors

460: # ── the proxy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

462: class Proxy(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
463:     server_version = "route/1"
464: 
465:     def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # the ledger is the log
466:         pass
467: 
468:     def _send(self, code: int, obj: dict) -> None:
469:         data = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
470:         self.send_response(code)
471:         self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
472:         self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
473:         self.end_headers()
474:         self.wfile.write(data)
475: 
476:     def _error(self, code: int, message: str, kind: str) -> None:
477:         self._send(code, {"error": {"message": message, "type": kind, "code": code}})
478: 
479:     def _who(self) -> tuple[str, str | None, int]:
480:         token = (self.headers.get("Authorization") or "").removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
481:         if not token.startswith("route:"):
482:             raise PermissionError("name the caller in the API key: route:<purpose>:<document slug or ->[:<attempt>]")
483:         parts = token.split(":")
484:         purpose = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 and parts[1] else "unnamed"
485:         attempt = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 and parts[3].isdigit() else 0
486:         return purpose, check_doc(parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else None), attempt
487: 
488:     def do_GET(self):  # noqa: N802
489:         if self.path.rstrip("/").endswith("/health"):  # cgr's litellm_proxy provider asks this first
490:             return self._send(200, {"status": "ok"})
491:         if self.path.rstrip("/").endswith("/models"):
492:             data = [{"id": m, "object": "model", "owned_by": "openrouter-free"} for m in rotation()]
493:             data.append({"id": f"local/{EMBED_MODEL}", "object": "model", "owned_by": "local"})
494:             return self._send(200, {"object": "list", "data": data})

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""One door for every model call a tool makes — priced, consented and recorded before it is sent.

The cost rule, in the order work is tried:

  1. decidable            -> code. It never reaches this module.
  2. a typed judgement    -> Jev (`jev()`): yes/no, one of a set, a score. Per call.
  3. generation           -> an OpenRouter model whose listed price is 0, sent with
                             provider.data_collection = "deny". Nothing else, ever.
  4. synthesis            -> the Claude agent that called the tool. Not routed.

Three guards are code, not prose (P1), and each says what it could not check (P23):

- **Free only.** A model is used only if it is OpenRouter's declared `:free` variant
  AND every price its catalogue lists is 0 — neither the name nor the price alone —
  and a response that reports `usage.cost > 0` stops the run.
- **Consent.** `Plan/runs/route/consent.json` (decision 007) names the documents
  that may be sent. A call declaring any other document is refused, and so is any
  request containing twelve consecutive words of a landed document outside the
  consent. Blind to: paraphrase, translation, and runs shorter than twelve words.

part.text: scripts/route.py is an OpenRouter proxy system that routes tool calls through free AI models while enforcing strict data policies, consent rules, and comprehensive logging. It provides command-line interfaces for model probing, serving as a proxy for third-party tools, maintaining audit ledgers, checking document consent, and running automated self-tests. The module implements three critical safeguards: using only declared free models with zero pricing, verifying document consent before transmission, and recording every call for offline replay and auditing purposes. It additionally provides local multilingual embedding through a sentence transformer model since no free remote embedding models accept the data policy, while also handling caching, rate limiting, and cost prevention. Finally, it serves as a security layer that prevents exposure of real API keys by routing all calls through OpenRouter with data_collection=deny and using a single authenticated endpoint for third-party tool integration.
